IV-A System Overview
The core idea of SNI-GNN is to mitigate embedding staleness by predicting the current values of remote embeddings directly within the network, thus reducing the need for frequent synchronization.
Our design is guided by two key observations fr

n.
Our design is guided by two key observations from empirical studies of GNN training dynamics. First, as shown in Figure 5, embedding vectors evolve smoothly over time, making them amenable to temporal forecasting.
Second, different embedding dimensions exhibit distinct evolution patterns, suggest

sions exhibit distinct evolution patterns, suggesting that per-dimension modeling would be ideal but computationally prohibitive for resource-constrained SmartNICs.
This tension motivates our design of a single lightweight predictor that operates across all dimensions, complemented by strategic samp

oss all dimensions, complemented by strategic sampling to maintain feasibility.
In the following, we first introduce the design details of our lightweight predictor model (Section IV-B), followed by SmartNICs-specific system optimizations to reduce prediction latency (Section IV-C).

Training Workflow.
Figure 6 illustrates the overall architecture of SNI-GNN in a multi-node distributed training setup.
As initialization, SNI-GNN performs a one-time graph partitioning and each node holds a subgraph. Each node consists of a GPU for model computatio

. Each node consists of a GPU for model computation and a SmartNIC (DPU) for in-network processing. During training, the DPU maintains historical embedding caches and performs lightweight prediction, while the GPU handles the main GNN computation. The architecture supports two operational modes: Syn

e architecture supports two operational modes: Sync Epochs, where fresh embeddings are exchanged between nodes and DPU caches are updated, and Stale Epochs, where DPUs supply predicted embeddings to local GPUs. This design effectively positions the SmartNIC as an intelligent communication filter bet

martNIC as an intelligent communication filter between the GPU and network, enabling embedding prediction directly in the data path.
